aboutMe.name: Harris Arvanitis
aboutMe.details:
Senior Software Engineer with 17+ years of experience delivering enterprise software for financial and regulated business domains. Specialised in .NET, C#, Angular, TypeScript, SQL Server, and end-to-end application architecture from business requirements and data modelling to production delivery.
Currently building large-scale financial-platform functionality and contributing to AI-assisted engineering adoption through tool evaluation, workflow design, and practical enablement for development teams.

MSc in Advanced Software Development and Artificial Intelligence, University of Piraeus.

education.name: MSc - Advanced Informatics and Computing Systems - Software Development and Artificial Intelligence
education.more: Thesis: Real-time emotion recognition and analytics in a mobile learning application (grade: 9.63/10)

education.name: BSc - Electronics Engineering, Data Communications and Networking
education.more: Thesis: Effects of Electromagnetic Radiation of Mobile Phones on Humans

roles.role: Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer
details: Develop and maintain Qualco's enterprise NPL (Non-Performing Loan) management platform using Angular, TypeScript, .NET, and Microsoft SQL Server, delivering scalable full-stack functionality for business-critical workflows.
Primary contributor for the Plan Calculation module in the QLM platform, responsible for implementing and maintaining critical financial computation logic in a regulated banking system.
Support AI-assisted engineering adoption by evaluating tools and models, creating reusable prompts and guidance, training teams, and assessing effort-reduction opportunities across the SDLC.
Design, develop, and maintain Qualco's enterprise Debt Management system serving complex business workflows.
Analyzed business requirements and translated them into technical solutions.
Designed, developed, and maintained end-to-end desktop application features across UI, business logic, and data access layers using C# and VB.NET with DevExpress and Infragistics frameworks.
Developed and optimized SQL Server database objects and T-SQL code, implementing business functionality while improving application performance and reliability.

roles.role: Senior Software Engineer - Head of IS
details: Led the Information Systems function, providing technical direction and software strategy to company leadership.
Designed and implemented enterprise software solutions using .NET and SQL Server.
Integrated enterprise systems including ERP, WMS, and regulatory platforms.
Developed data models, reporting systems, and analytics solutions to support decision-making.
Built and maintained applications and reporting solutions integrated with JD Edwards ERP.
Designed and optimized SQL Server databases for performance and reliability.
Managed Oracle JD Edwards ERP system administration.
Performed data analysis and reporting using T-SQL and Python.
Provided ERP, CRM, WMS, and e-commerce system consulting and technical support.
Developed and customized enterprise applications.
Administered databases (Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle).
Developed reports and software solutions.
Managed Windows and Linux server infrastructure and enterprise network systems.
